en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the sun sets, the time for the two Salāts (Al-Maghrib and Al-Isha) enters, unless this is before this’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When it is sunset, it is time for two Salah (prayer) except that this is before that.’”
